en: Sepia-toned street view of a historic European city with ornate multi‑story buildings, trams running along cobblestone tracks, and people in early 20th‑century clothing walking on the sidewalks. The left side shows a large Renaissance-style building with arched entrance and decorative windows, while church-like towers rise in the distance. Printed caption text at the top right reads in red, and a hanging sign with smaller text is visible on the right side.
